articles.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
articles.snippet: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
articles.snippet: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
articles.snippet: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem
articles.snippet: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

articles.title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
articles.snippet: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.
